name: Flexi Subscription for WooCommerce
author: flexiplugins

sections.description:
Flexi Subscription is a WooCommerce subscription plugin designed to help store
owners create, manage, and grow recurring subscription products with ease. It
allows businesses to offer subscription-based, recurring, and membership-style
products directly within WooCommerce using a modern, WooCommerce-native
approach. The plugin is built to fit naturally into existing WooCommerce
workflows, making it easy to set up subscriptions, handle ongoing billing, and
manage subscription lifecycles without relying on complex or third-party
systems. Whether you are launching your first recurring product or planning to
scale subscription-based offerings over time, Flexi Subscription provides a
stable and flexible foundation while staying fully compatible with the latest
WooCommerce features and updates.

With Flexi Subscription for WooCommerce, you can:

  • Create and sell recurring subscription products in WooCommerce
  • Manage subscription billing cycles, renewals, and statuses
  • Display clear subscription details in the Cart and Checkout
  • Show a compact “Subscription Summary” for better customer clarity
  • Build WooCommerce-native subscription workflows with extensibility in mind

Free Version Features

  • Create subscriptions for simple WooCommerce products
  • Configure billing intervals and billing periods
  • Handle subscription renewals and lifecycle statuses
  • Customize line-item price text for subscription-based products
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce Blocks checkout experiences
  • Built with WooCommerce-native UX and extensible architecture

Pro Version Features

The Pro version of Flexi Subscription is currently under active development and
extends the Free plugin with advanced subscription functionality for growing
WooCommerce businesses.

  • Support subscriptions for variable products and variations
  • Configure subscription settings at the variation level
  • Add signup fees, trials, and synchronization options
  • Separate delivery schedules from billing cycles
  • Define delivery intervals, periods, and delivery synchronization rules
  • Access developer-friendly APIs, hooks, and filters
  • Maintain performance, scalability, and WooCommerce-native UX patterns

Flexi Subscription is ideal for store owners who want a lightweight,
future-ready WooCommerce subscription plugin that starts simple and scales
into more advanced subscription use cases over time.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the flexi-subscription folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Add subscription product from woocommerce product screen.
